title: core: Python analyzer (variables, CFG, types, use-sites)
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W1]
Seats: INTEL-04
Add crates/core/src/analyze/python.rs implementing the same output shape as INTEL-2's rust.rs using tree-sitter-python: variables (assignment targets, params, class attributes/globals) with read/write counts and scope; FunctionCfg (if/elif/else, for/while, try/except, with, return) with cyclomatic + nesting; TypeNode for classes (fields from self.x assignments, methods, docstring); UseSites for calls/field access/var reads+writes. Reuse analyze/mod.rs shared helpers from INTEL-2 (import them; do not duplicate). Owner: crates/core/src/analyze/python.rs only. Depends: INTEL-2 (analyze/mod.rs helpers) — if INTEL-2 has not landed yet, coordinate through the card. Verify: cargo test -p repowalk-core (inline test on a small python snippet: for+if -> cyclomatic, unused variable, class with method).
